purpose: Provider-swappable model config for the so:om surface (the user<->agent F/G chat element / pip — Sam's 'harness'). Keyless-first: the default + fallbacks need NO api key. Resolved #64 / T=239.
note: IDE agents (Antigravity = Google-AI plan, Claude Code = its plan) bring their own auth — NOT these keys. This config is only for a self-built chat/pip element.

gemini-flash.note: AI-Studio endpoint, simplest. Key fetched from Secret Manager by Get-Secrets.ps1. OPTIONAL — prefer Vertex if you don't want any key. Set `model` to the current Flash id.

gemini-flash-vertex.note: Vertex via ADC — ZERO api key (the keyless path). Needs aiplatform.googleapis.com enabled. Same Flash model, no secret to manage.

ollama-local.note: Offline fallback on the Z440 RTX 3060. Swap `model` for a smaller/faster one (gemma3:12b, phi4) for a snappier pip.

anthropic.note: Second-brain option — add a key in Secret Manager only if you want it. Claude Code itself runs on its own plan, not this key.
